title: How to Do NZ on a Family Budget — Real Costs and Where to Cut
meta_desc: Discover how to explore NZ with your family without breaking the bank, with practical budget tips
intro: With a little planning, you can have a fantastic family holiday in New Zealand without overspending. For a family of four, a daily budget of $250-350 NZD can cover all expenses. From self-catering apartments to cheap accommodation options, we've got you covered.

sections.heading: Accommodation on a Budget
sections.body: One of the biggest expenses for families is accommodation. Consider self-catering apartments or holiday homes, which can be more cost-effective than hotels. For example, a 2-bedroom apartment in Queenstown can cost around $180-250 NZD per night, while a similar hotel room can cost upwards of $350 NZD per night.

sections.heading: Free Activities for Families
list: Visit the Auckland Art Gallery Toi o Tāmaki (free admission)
Explore the Wellington Botanic Garden (free admission)
Go hiking in the beautiful NZ landscapes, such as the Tongariro Alpine Crossing (free, but $40 NZD for parking)
Visit the Auckland Museum (free admission for children under 5, $25 NZD for adults)

sections.heading: Food on a Budget
sections.body: Eating out can be expensive, especially for families. Consider self-catering and buying groceries from local supermarkets like Countdown or New World. A weekly grocery budget of $150-200 NZD can cover the basics for a family of four. You can also find affordable eating options at local cafes or food courts, such as the $15 NZD meals at the Queenstown Mall food court.

sections.heading: Transportation Costs
sections.body: If you're planning to explore NZ by car, consider renting a vehicle or buying a cheap second-hand car. Petrol prices can range from $2.20-2.50 NZD per litre, depending on the location. For example, driving from Auckland to Rotorua can take around 3 hours and cost around $50-70 NZD in petrol.

sections.heading: Realistic Weekly Spend
sections.body: For a family of four, a realistic weekly budget can range from $1,750-2,450 NZD, depending on your accommodation choices and activities. Here's a breakdown of estimated weekly costs: $1,000-1,400 NZD for accommodation, $500-700 NZD for food, $200-300 NZD for transportation, and $50-100 NZD for activities.
